title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1983-10-15
lineage: Master Cassette > Sony TC-D5M > Edirol UA5 Custom Oade Mod > USB > IBM R40 > Sound Forge 5.0 > EAC (no errors) > WinXP Pro > Flac Frontend > FLAC16
source: 2 Nak 700's pointed to stacks, FOB, Section 2, Row R, Seat 8 > Maxell MX 90 > Sony TC-D5M

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy show highlighted by a roaring St. Stephen, captured in a lively front‑of‑house (FOB) recording.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the groove‑filled performance, especially the electrifying St. Stephen that sends the crowd into a roar. The FOB recording preserves that audience energy better than the soundboard, offering a clear and engaging listening experience despite missing some fine‑mix detail.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and praised both the musical excitement and the recording’s ability to capture crowd energy, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house (FOB) capture delivers the roar of the audience during St. Stephen; some nuance is lost compared with a pure soundboard, but overall clarity and ambience are praised.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers note the band was firmly in a groove all night, delivering a consistently smoking performance with no major dips.
